remove-dead-outputs.description: Remove usages of outputs removed in this version that had already stopped firing: Overlay's onAnimationStart/onAnimationDone (and OverlayOptions config callbacks), and MenubarSub's menuFocus/menuBlur/menuKeydown.

styleclass-to-class.description: Rewrite styleClass/[styleClass] to class/[class] on selectors whose styleClass input was removed in this version in favor of the native class attribute: p-toast, p-message, p-tag, p-skeleton, p-card, p-radiobutton/p-radioButton/p-radio-button, p-progressbar/p-progressBar/p-progress-bar, p-divider, p-progressspinner/p-progressSpinner/p-progress-spinner, p-timeline, p-toolbar, p-avatar, p-chip, p-inputgroup/p-inputGroup/p-input-group, p-iconfield/p-iconField/p-icon-field, p-inputicon/p-inputIcon/p-input-icon, p-toggleswitch/p-toggleSwitch/p-toggle-switch, p-colorpicker/p-colorPicker/p-color-picker, p-metergroup/p-meterGroup/p-meter-group, p-inplace, p-togglebutton/p-toggleButton/p-toggle-button, p-terminal, p-blockui/p-blockUI/p-block-ui, p-badge, p-checkbox/p-checkBox/p-check-box, p-panel, p-dock, p-accordion, p-knob, p-splitter, p-scrollpanel/p-scrollPanel/p-scroll-panel, p-image, p-editor, p-slider, p-paginator, p-organizationchart/p-organizationChart/p-organization-chart, p-carousel, p-dataview/p-dataView/p-data-view, p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button, p-password, p-inputnumber/p-inputNumber/p-input-number, p-menubar, p-panelmenu/p-panelMenu/p-panel-menu, p-megamenu/p-megaMenu/p-mega-menu, p-cascadeselect/p-cascadeSelect/p-cascade-select, p-datepicker/p-datePicker/p-date-picker, p-tree and p-select.

remove-dead-inputs.description: Remove usages of inputs removed in this version that had already stopped doing anything: showTransformOptions, hideTransformOptions, showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-toast; showTransformOptions, hideTransformOptions, showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-toastItem; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-message; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-overlay; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-colorPicker/p-colorpicker/p-color-picker; size of p-overlayBadge/p-overlay-badge/p-overlaybadge; transitionOptions of p-fieldset; transitionOptions of p-panel; transitionOptions of p-accordion; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-scrollTop/p-scrolltop/p-scroll-top; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-confirmpopup; inputId of p-togglebutton/p-toggleButton/p-toggle-button; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions and ariaCloseLabel of p-popover; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions, modalEnterAnimation and modalLeaveAnimation of p-image; transitionOptions of p-drawer; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-menu; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions and plain of p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-password; badgeClass of p-button; autoZIndex, baseZIndex and popup of p-contextMenuSub/p-contextmenu-sub; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-tieredMenu/p-tieredmenu/p-tiered-menu; autoZIndex and baseZIndex of p-menubar; autoZIndex, baseZIndex, mobileActive, ariaLabel and ariaLabelledBy of p-menubarSub/p-menubarsub; transitionOptions and tabindex of p-panelMenu/p-panelmenu/p-panel-menu; disabled and queryMatches of p-megaMenuSub/p-megamenu-sub; showTransitionOptions, hideTransitionOptions and containerClass of p-galleria; removeStyleClass of p-fileupload/p-fileUpload; inputLabel and emptyMessage of p-cascadeSelect/p-cascadeselect/p-cascade-select; showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-datePicker/p-datepicker/p-date-picker; transitionOptions and rtl of p-dialog; closeAriaLabel, acceptAriaLabel, rejectAriaLabel, rtl, transitionOptions, focusTrap and defaultFocus of p-confirmDialog/p-confirmdialog/p-confirm-dialog; rowNode, root, firstChild and lastChild of p-treeNode; visible and itemSize of p-selectItem. The dead dir input of p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button is removed too, but its dir/[dir] bindings are left in place: they keep working as the host element's native dir attribute. Programmatic reads/writes of the removed names are reported for manual review.

config-overlay-options-signal.description: Rewrite programmatic access to Exhaustive.overlayOptions, which is a signal in this version: assignments become .set(value) and reads become () calls.
